name: Pacific
long_description:
We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week.

Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue.

Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. 

We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.
one_liner: Mass-producing and financing micro data center incredibly quickly.

launches.body:
**Building the toughest super computers for earth and space**\
\
**TL;DR:** Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing $1B per week in the US alone, in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rf8cCV6qFow>

**The deal**

If you need compute (GPU hours, tokens, capacity for a training run) send us a note. We sell short and long-term contracts below market rate.

If your data has to stay on-prem (**defense, CUI, CMMC)**, we sell managed, modular pods directly and are already working with large aerospace companies.

**We're building factories**

SpaceX didn't just build rockets, they built rocket factories. We do the same and our first factory stands up over the next few months, potentially funded by the state of Missouri. We vertically integrate the critical components that currently carry multi-year lead times: transformers, switchgear and power distribution, and by taking control of our own supply chain we ensure we can build pods fast enough.

**Financed like aircraft**

Our pods are financed like aircraft - debt at **\~5-6%, not 11-15%**. A data center is a risky construction loan: money stuck in a half-built site for years, and if it fails the lender holds a building and a pile of GPUs priced by a brutally volatile market - the banks are freaking out. Our pods leave the factory fully functional, earns the moment it's connected to power, and can be repossessed and redeployed: the profile of equipment finance, far faster and cheaper.

**Traction**

Today we have $95M in LOI’s for our hosted compute and a further $27M for direct sales of our pods. Our first two clusters go live in Missouri this month, followed by the first modular factory.

**Our asks**

* **Compute buyers and offtake.** We'd love to speak to anyone buying compute, or setting up on-prem deployments, or needing CMMC compliance. Introductions to procurement teams at OpenAI, Anthropic, or any startup constrained by access to cheap compute would be incredible.
* **Hiring.** Data center engineers, electrical engineers, any data center nerds you know.
* **Financiers.** These projects run on capital from infra investors and tech lenders. If you've worked in that world, we'd love to chat.
* **Construction sites.** If you sell to construction sites, work in construction, mining, or fab production, or own a site yourself - we will put a money machine on it. Let's chat.

**Join us as we build supercomputers for the galaxy!**
